headline_marked: US and Iran [[restart peace talks through mediators]] after 7 months of conflict
headline: US and Iran restart peace talks through mediators after 7 months of conflict
summary: Officials from both countries separately engaged mediators on Monday to discuss a revised version of Iran's seven-day ceasefire proposal, aiming to end the prolonged conflict.
details: The United States and Iran have reportedly resumed efforts to end their seven-month-long conflict. Officials from both nations held separate discussions with mediators on Monday, according to Reuters.

An official familiar with the talks indicated that discussions might revolve around a revised version of Iran's seven-day ceasefire proposal. This proposal was initially presented last week on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly session.

Iran's Foreign Minister, Abbas Araghchi, remains in New York after attending the UN General Assembly. Iran's state news agency IRNA reports he is awaiting a response from the US regarding the ceasefire proposal and conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz.

Araghchi stated, "If the Americans say they want a deal or a peaceful solution, then we have presented that solution." US President Donald Trump also confirmed on Monday that US officials had spoken with mediators, though he did not provide further details.

Iran's proposal includes ending all conflicts in Iran and Lebanon, unfreezing billions of dollars in Iranian assets, lifting sanctions on Iranian oil, and removing US blockades on Iranian ports. In return, Iran would permit the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.
The two sides are also expected to restart discussions on Iran's nuclear program and Trump's desire to seize or destroy Iran's highly enriched uranium.
Previously, on Saturday, Trump announced he had rejected Iran's initial proposal, claiming Iran was seeking a quick deal due to economic pressure.

The conflict began in late February with attacks by the US and Israel on Iran, resulting in thousands of casualties over seven months. It has also significantly impacted global markets due to the closure of vital oil shipping lanes.
Earlier attempts at peace talks through mediators in April and June saw the US and Iran agree to ceasefires twice. However, both previous ceasefires quickly collapsed.

headline_marked: [[BTS wins 3 MTV VMAs]] after comeback; Lisa makes history with Best Pop award
headline: BTS wins 3 MTV VMAs after comeback; Lisa makes history with Best Pop award
summary: K-Pop sensation BTS secured three major awards at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards, including 'Song of the Year' for 'Swim'. Blackpink's Lisa also made history, becoming the first Asian solo artist to win 'Best Pop'.
details: K-Pop band BTS achieved significant success in their comeback year, winning three awards at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards (VMAs). The group secured 'Song of the Year' for their track 'Swim', along with 'Best K-Pop' and 'Best Group' honors.

The awards were announced on Sunday in Los Angeles, USA, although no BTS members were present at the ceremony. Following their wins, BTS issued a statement through their agency, BigHit Music, expressing gratitude to their fans, known as 'ARMY'.
'Swim' is the lead single from BTS's fifth studio album, 'Arirang'. The members stated in their message that 'Arirang' represents a new beginning for them, making these awards even more meaningful.

After its release in March, 'Swim' topped the Billboard Hot 100 chart on April 4 and reached the second spot on the UK Official Singles Chart. The song also maintained its position at the top of Spotify's global daily songs chart for 25 consecutive days.
This marks BTS's fifth 'Best Group' award at the VMAs, making them the most awarded artist in this category in VMA history. They previously won the award consecutively from 2019 to 2022.

Since their first nomination in 2019, BTS has accumulated over a dozen VMA awards across various categories, including 'Best Choreography' and 'Song of the Summer'. In 2020, they also won 'Best Pop' for their song 'On'.

Following the VMAs, the group is set to embark on a world tour. The South American leg of the 'BTS World Tour - Arirang' will commence on Friday in Bogota, Colombia, with 14 concerts scheduled across five cities including Lima, Santiago, Buenos Aires, and Sao Paulo.
Blackpink's Lisa also made history at this year's VMAs, winning the 'Best Pop' award for her song 'Dream'. She is the first Asian solo artist to receive this prestigious award in VMA history.
